note: La Crosse County campground 3 mi S of La Crosse on a long strip beside the Mississippi backwaters (about 320 numbered sites). Riverfront on the west shore row only: of its sites a 23-ft rig fits, 65 and 66 (20 A) sit on the open bank, and 169-180 (first come, first served, RVs to 25 ft, when the ground allows) line the shore under scattered cottonwoods; the rest of that row is 18-22 ft sites. Swimming beach and three boat launches. --Claude
summary: County page, 2026 fee PDF and layout map read in the headless browser; WebTrac read for sites 001-089 before Cloudflare blocked it. $32-38 RV nights (+$8 reservation fee), 20/30/50 A + water, no sewer, sites to 45 ft, season Apr 15-Oct 30, online stays up to 7 nights, 169-180 FCFS. Riverfront kept with a caveat naming 65-66 and 169-180. Pin at the entrance - move ~600 m to the loops. Google 4.4/534.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront kept (sweep value, no --AWH) WITH A CAVEAT. The backwater is ~250+ m wide (well over 30 m). The shore row 50-68 sits on an open grassy bank 5-25 m from the water around 43.7330,-91.2312, but WebTrac lists 050-064 and 067-068 as 20 A sites 'up to 18'' to 22' or 'Popup' - only 065 and 066 ('up to 24'', $32/night, booked nightly online) fit a 23-ft rig. Sites 169-180 (~43.7290-43.7305,-91.2335 to -91.2325) line the shore behind spaced cottonwoods, FCFS nightly, 'RV size limit is 25'', 'if ground conditions allow for use'. 71-73 and 121-149 are rustic tent sites. If the reviewer reads 169-180's cottonwoods as a tree line and two 20 A sites as too thin, the fallback is riverview.

PIN: stored 43.7358,-91.2276 is the entrance/registration road junction at the north end; move to the middle of the camping strip at 43.7310,-91.2312 (~600 m). The county page's own 'GPS Coordinates 43.637727,-91.109533' are ~14 km wrong; Google 43.734952,-91.2290242 is also at the north end.

SEASON: closes 10-31 -> 10-30 (county page and fee schedule 'April 15th to October 30th'); opens 04-15 (2027: 'Tuesday April 15th, 2027' per WebTrac - note April 15, 2027 is actually a Thursday; the page's weekday is wrong, the date stands).

SITES: stored max_rig_ft 42 had no source -> 45 (site 001). Stored pull_through true had no source and nothing read shows pull-throughs -> cleared. No site count set: the 2017 layout numbers 1-326 (some rustic tent sites among them); the inclusion_evidence's '300+ sites' is consistent.

NIGHTLY SHARE (county park with seasonal and 28-night rates and a 'Seasonal Site Waiting List Policy'): of sites 001-089, about 60 appear in the nightly WebTrac catalog (the missing ones are presumably seasonal); 85 water/electric sites alone are bookable online, plus 12 FCFS. Roughly two-thirds nightly - not a long-stay concern. Google Maps 4.4 / 534 reviews.

BOOKING: online stays capped at 7 nights ('Longer stays must be done through our campground office'); 3-night holiday minimum (Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, when the holiday falls Fri-Mon) - not a standing minimum.
PHONE 608-788-7018 confirmed (page and Google). WEBSITE kept (both links live in the headless browser; the county site and WebTrac block bots after a few pages).
LEAD: none new. 3592 Veterans Memorial (West Salem) is the county's other campground, already in the DB.
